Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 88. Category: form. Ancient Saiyan Power.

Power-Up
This is the true raw power of the ancient Saiyans,
their bodies bulk slightly like super Saiyans but
otherwise look like their base form. Their ki rises off
them like steam and they have been known to growl like
animals.
Increase your Power by 2
Increase your Movement Speed by 15 ft.
You deal an additional 1d4 to all damage
At the end of your turn, you lose 2 Stamina
Gained at level 10
Shallot
